title.zh: 遗产税豁免——亚洲美元债券——（合并）公告
title.en: Estate Duty Exemptions — Asian Dollar Bonds — (Consolidation) Notification

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 1 条。

text.en:
Estate Duty Act
(Chapter 96, Section 12(1)(c))
Estate Duty Exemptions — Asian Dollar Bonds — (Consolidation) Notification
N 5
G.N. No. S 38/1994
REVISED EDITION 1994
(1st April 1995)
The Minister for Finance has approved the following Asian Dollar Bonds for exemption from estate duty:
(1)The Kao Corporation U.S. $300,000,000 4¾ per cent. Notes 1994 with Warrants.
[S 38/94]
[28.1.94]
(2)The Province of Nova Scotia U.S. $500,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 1999.
[S 316/94]
[12.8.94]
(3)The Shandong International Trust & Investment Corporation U.S. $130,000,000 Floating Rate Notes due 2001.
[S 391/94]
[7.10.94]
